ee5a48a682.fzText: To qualify for the final exam, students need to 1) have submitted the midterm exam, 2) have completed the assignments, 3) have attended at least 70% of the course, AND 4) have collected a total of at least 15 points from the midterm and assignments. Failure to comply with any of these requirements will result in an FZ grade.
